title: EXPANSION OF EMRS IN WEST BENGAL
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Tribal Affairs

EXPANSION OF EMRS IN WEST BENGAL

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
30 JUL 2026 1:35PM by PIB Delhi

Replying to a question in Lok Sabha today the Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Shri Durgadas Uikey informed that Bundwan block of Purulia district in West Bengal is the only block meeting the prescribed criteria for establishment of Eklavya Model Residential School (EMRS). The land for said block has been identified by State Government.

As reported by the State Government, EMRS in Kalimpong is functional in alternate building and the construction of permanent building has commenced. A total of Rs 20.91 Cr has been approved for EMRS Kalimpong out of which Rs. 9.96 Cr has been released.

Under the existing scheme, the establishment of EMRS is based on 2011 census.
